'''Hunter killer droids''' were large, lumbering [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] that were outdated<ref name="RA" /> by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].<ref name="TNEC" /> Also known as a '''war droid''', one hunter killer droid, [[8-13]], was stationed on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]]<ref name="RA" /> during 5 ABY.<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]'' to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].</ref>
